title: Pure Gadget
summary: Gadget monsters with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Every Gadget is a Level 4 Machine that replaces itself. Green, Red and Yellow Gadget search each other in a loop on every summon. Gold Gadget and Silver Gadget summon another Level 4 Machine from the hand, and when they are destroyed they summon a Level 4 Gadget from the Deck. Platinum Gadget, the Link-2, puts a Machine from the hand next to itself and floats into a Gadget as well. Pairs of Level 4 Machines become Gear Gigant X, which searches the next Gadget, or any generic Rank 4. Gadget Trio, the newest Gadget, only searches Shining Sarcophagus cards, so it plays on that page's list instead. Gadget Gamer and Gadget Box support Morphtronic and stay out too.

allow.Gear Gigant X: Generic Machine Rank 4 that searches a Gadget; tagged Geargia only because of its second effect.

exclude.Gadget Trio: Searches only Shining Sarcophagus cards; it is on the Shining Sarcophagus list.
exclude.Gadget Box: Morphtronic card that limits the Extra Deck to Synchro Monsters.
